text:
incident-bot: PAGER: [SEV2] Azure UK South (uksouth) — control-plane DNS failures affecting Private connectors. Alert INC-2026-UKS-DNS. Please ack in #incidents and start triage. https://status.azure.com/incident/uksouth

jordan (oncall): acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — looking at controlplane -> private connector errors. Which clusters/tenants are hitting this?

priya (sre): Seeing 502s and DNS NXDOMAINs for controlplane.service.redwood.internal from our private gateways starting ~2026-03-15T09:10Z. Impacting ~12 tenants in UK/EU bound to uksouth private connectors. Graphs: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abcd/controlplane-dns-errors

kevin (netops): I can confirm inconsistent DNS responses across uksouth name servers. Ran a few digs from our edge probes:
```
; <<>> DiG 9.11.3 <<>> controlplane.service.redwood.internal @ns1-uksouth.azure.net
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NXDOMAIN, id: 54321
;; flags: qr rd ra; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1, ADDITIONAL: 1
;; WARNING: recursion requested but not available
;; SERVER: 10.1.2.3#53(10.1.2.3)
;; WHEN: Mon Mar 15 09:12:01 UTC 2026

```

kevin (netops): Also checked Azure DNS zone — some record-sets appear absent from a subset of name servers. Opening support ticket with MSFT.

sam (platform): Can we push a config fallback so Private connectors query our global fallback DNS (external to uksouth) until Azure stabilizes? Low-risk plan: 1) add temporary CNAME override in controlplane config map pointing controlplane.service.redwood.internal -> controlplane-ext.syn.redwood.net (hosted in gslb outside uksouth), 2) keep TTL low (30s) so rollback is quick. Anyone object?

priya (sre): +1. Also we should throttle new connections so we don't pile on failing lookups. I'll add a short circuit in gateway to treat NXDOMAIN as transient and retry to fallback.

jordan (oncall): Go ahead with override. Documenting customer impact: 12 tenants impacted, mostly degraded API calls; a few have failover to Dedicated and saw no impact. CS notified top 5.

maria (cs): Thanks — drafting notices now. Will call top customers after we stabilize.

jordan (oncall): Applying override for all uksouth private connectors now. Pushing change to controlplane configmap for the region.

deploy-bot: DNS override configmap patch pushed by jordan-prod at 2026-03-15T09:22Z for namespace controlplane-uksouth.

sam (platform): Rolling restart gateways in uksouth to pick up config. Command: `kubectl -n controlplane-uksouth rollout restart deployment/gateway --timeout=5m`

priya (sre): I'm throttling gateway DNS resolution retries to reduce noise. Also raising alert thresholds to catch persistent fails.

kevin (netops): Azure support responded — they confirm partial outage in uksouth DNS fabric affecting delegated zones after a config propagation failure. MSFT engineers looking at it; ETA TBD.

jordan (oncall): After override, error rate dropped from ~42% -> ~4% for affected tenants. Still watching for residual errors. Metrics:
```
controlplane_responses_5m: before=42% errors at 09:15Z, after=4% errors at 09:28Z
request_latency_p95: before=950ms, after=320ms
```

maria (cs): Sending customer update: "We're aware of DNS-related connectivity issues in Azure UK South. We've applied a temporary routing override to restore connectivity while upstream fixes are applied by the provider. We'll update once resolved."

jordan (oncall): Current mitigation works. I'm going to prepare handoff notes for the EMEA night oncall. Sam, can you take the incident for sustained monitoring and incident review?

sam (platform): Ack, taking over. I'll keep 15m cadence checks and escalate any reappearance. Plan: leave override for now, coordinate with kevin to track MSFT progress, and prepare rollback once provider declares fix and our tests pass.

kevin (netops): MSFT updated: root cause = internal DNS config push that failed to replicate across all name servers; fix applied to majority at 10:58Z, full propagation expected by 11:10Z. They ask customers to avoid additional zone changes.

deploy-bot: Healthcheck run by sam at 11:05Z: all uksouth private gateway probes OK (0 NXDOMAIN in last 5m).

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Azure reports propagation completed. Temporary override rolled back at 11:12Z after validation. Final state: controlplane DNS stable across uksouth name servers. Incident duration ~2h. Root cause: upstream DNS propagation failure.

jordan (oncall): Closing incident. Summary for postmortem: upstream DNS propagation failure in Azure uksouth caused NXDOMAINs for delegated zone, affecting Private connectors' control plane lookups. We mitigated with a temporary CNAME override to our external controlplane, throttled retries, and coordinated with Azure support. Action items: - run a table of which tenants used uksouth private connectors and confirm no data loss - add a runbook for DNS overrides in Private control plane - automate health-check rollback window and tighter alerting thresholds.

sam (platform): I'll own the runbook and follow-up with kevin to sync with MSFT notes.

maria (cs): I'll send the post-incident customer note and follow up with contacts.

jordan (oncall): Handing off to sam for the post-incident review. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
